domain-information: A procurement officer evaluates supplier offers to purchase raw logs for the sawmill.
A procurement officer arranges transportation for incoming log shipments containing raw logs from forest suppliers.
A sawmill operator inspects incoming logs and sorts them by type and quality.
A sawmill operator cuts logs into lumber according to production orders.
A sawmill operator records production output of lumber and forwards it to the warehouse supervisor.
A warehouse supervisor receives processed lumber and updates stock records.
A warehouse supervisor records storage locations based on lumber type and quality.
A warehouse supervisor prepares lumber batches for shipment when orders are confirmed.
A sales representative receives customer orders and confirms product availability with the warehouse.
A sales representative creates sales orders and forwards them to the logistics coordinator for delivery planning.
A sales representative updates customers on order status and expected delivery times.
A logistics coordinator plans lumber deliveries based on destination and load size.
A logistics coordinator checks with drivers to ensure all delivery documents are ready before departure.
A logistics coordinator reports completed deliveries to the sales representative for billing confirmation.

domain objects.name: Procurement Officer
domain objects.description: Employee responsible for sourcing and purchasing raw logs from suppliers.

domain objects.name: Supplier Offer
domain objects.description: Proposal from a forest supplier detailing price, volume, and type of logs available.

domain objects.name: Forest Supplier
domain objects.description: External partner providing raw logs to the company.

domain objects.name: Log Shipment
domain objects.description: Delivery of raw logs from a supplier to the sawmill.

domain objects.name: Raw Log
domain objects.description: Unprocessed wood received from suppliers.

domain objects.name: Type
domain objects.description: Specifies the tree species or wood category of the log.

domain objects.name: Quality
domain objects.description: Indicates the grade or condition of the wood material.

domain objects.name: Sawmill Operator
domain objects.description: Worker who processes raw logs into lumber according to production orders.

domain objects.name: Production Order
domain objects.description: Instruction defining what type and amount of lumber should be produced.

domain objects.name: Production Output
domain objects.description: Resulting batch of processed lumber from a production run.

domain objects.name: Lumber
domain objects.description: Processed wood product ready for storage or sale.

domain objects.name: Warehouse Supervisor
domain objects.description: Employee managing storage, inventory, and shipment preparation of lumber.

domain objects.name: Stock Record
domain objects.description: Inventory entry tracking lumber quantities and storage locations.

domain objects.name: Location
domain objects.description: Specific place or area in the warehouse where lumber is stored.

domain objects.name: Lumber Batch
domain objects.description: Grouped collection of lumber units prepared for delivery.

domain objects.name: Sales Representative
domain objects.description: Staff member handling customer orders and communication.

domain objects.name: Customer Order
domain objects.description: Initial purchase request made by a customer for lumber products.

domain objects.name: Customer
domain objects.description: Buyer placing orders for lumber or related products.

domain objects.name: Sales Order
domain objects.description: Confirmed internal record of a customer's purchase to be fulfilled.

domain objects.name: Status Update
domain objects.description: Information provided to a customer regarding the progress of their order.

domain objects.name: Logistics Coordinator
domain objects.description: Planner responsible for organizing deliveries and coordinating drivers.

domain objects.name: Lumber Delivery
domain objects.description: Scheduled transport of lumber batches to a customer's destination.

domain objects.name: Destination
domain objects.description: Delivery address or client location where lumber is sent.

domain objects.name: Load Size
domain objects.description: Total volume or weight of lumber to be delivered.

domain objects.name: Delivery Documents
domain objects.description: Papers accompanying shipments such as delivery notes and transport manifests.

domain objects.name: Delivery Completion Report
domain objects.description: Record confirming that a delivery has been successfully completed.

domain objects.name: Driver
domain objects.description: Person responsible for transporting lumber batches to customers.

associations.description: Production Output goes to Warehouse Supervisor.
Lumber Batch sent to Logistics Coordinator.
Logistics Coordinator issues Delivery Completion Report.
Sales Order sent to Logistics Coordinator.
